claim: The completed PERSEUS PPMS registry record states that qualified researchers may request anonymized participant-level data and related documents through Vivli and lists placebo-controlled disability, MRI, NfL, CHI3L1, immunoglobulin, lymphocyte-subset, pharmacokinetic, and safety endpoints; results and actual shared-field completeness were not posted in the registry at access time.
future_grounding_route: Request NCT04458051 through Vivli after sponsor eligibility is confirmed; use a plan frozen before participant data to test the HERCULES-derived modifiers on a harmonized 24-month EDSS-confirmed progression endpoint, with PPMS transportability treated as a separate question.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: Independent randomized replication is required for any HERCULES treatment selector

project_use: Concrete same-compound, placebo-controlled independent-trial access route for falsifying or bounding HERCULES effect modifiers; access and usable fields are not assumed.
relationship_note: PERSEUS could provide an independent PPMS test of fixed HERCULES candidates. A failure to transport across SPMS and PPMS would demonstrate phenotype dependence, not necessarily invalidate the HERCULES average effect.

source.citation: ClinicalTrials.gov. NCT04458051, PERSEUS, study design, endpoint inventory, and IPD sharing statement.
source.label: PERSEUS ClinicalTrials.gov record

source_terms.reuse_notes: The record stores a short registry paraphrase. Approved controlled data and restricted documents must never be committed publicly.
